instructions: The marks are indicated in the right-hand margin.

questions.text:
What will be the output of this C code?

#include<stdio.h>
int main()
{
    char ch = 'A';
    printf("%d", sizeof('A'));
    return 0;
}

What will be the output of this C code?

#include<stdio.h>
int main()
{
    extern int i;
    i = 20;
    printf("%d", i);
    return 0;
}

What will be the output of this C code?

#include<stdio.h>
int main()
{
    int i = 100;
    {
        int i = 0;
        printf("%d", i==0);
    }
    return 0;
}

What will be the output of this C code?

#include<stdio.h>
int main(){
    int x=3, y=4, z;
    z = ++x * y++;
    printf("%d", z);
}
In C, if you pass an array as an argument to a function, what actually gets passed?
options: Address of the last element of array
